long_biography.plain_text:
After a water leak at his home, Mark Silver co-founded Eddy to make leak detection and shut-off less dependent on someone being on site. The company developed smart meters that monitor water flow and identify unusual patterns, allowing the supply to be cut automatically. The insurance consequences of his own leak made preventing damage part of the original idea.

Eddy initially sold door to door before concentrating on larger buildings and construction sites. Its approach combines equipment with monitoring and spreads installation costs across a multiyear service contract. Connecting devices throughout a high-rise also required a reliable communications network, leading the company to work with Rogers. The system can protect a building before residents move in.
